title: Notify an item's participants when a note lands on it
outcome: When a note is recorded on an Engram item, the sessions involved in that item (its holder, the project coordinator, and sessions that have noted on it) are told by a mailbox notification carrying the note's id, so a decision is recorded and announced in one act and the item is the one ordered thread everyone reads.
acceptance: Notify an item's participants when a note lands on it is done
